text_en: The lot for the tribe of the people of Judah according to their families reached southward to the boundary of Edom, to the wilderness of Zin at the farthest south.
text_cn: 犹大支派的子孙按照家族，抽签分得的土地是在极南部，以厄东边境为界，南至亲旷野。

text_en: And their south boundary ran from the end of the Dead Sea, from the bay that faces southward;
text_cn: 南方的边界起自盐海顶端，即海湾南端，

text_en: it goes out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, passes along to Zin, and goes up south of Kadesh-barnea, along by Hezron, up to Addar, makes a turn to Karka,
text_cn: 沿阿刻辣宾山坡之南，经亲旷野，上至卡德士巴尔乃亚之南，再由此经过赫兹龙，上至阿达尔，再绕过卡尔卡，

text_en: passes along to Azmon, goes out by the Wadi of Egypt, and comes to its end at the sea. This shall be your south boundary.
text_cn: 穿过阿兹孟直到埃及小河，而后延至大海：以上是他们南方的边界。

text_en: And the east boundary is the Dead Sea, to the mouth of the Jordan. And the boundary on the north side runs from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan;
text_cn: 东方的边界是自盐海直到约但河口；北方的边界是起自约但河口的海湾，

text_en: and the boundary goes up to Beth-hoglah, and passes along north of Beth-arabah; and the boundary goes up to the Stone of Bohan, Reuben’s son;
text_cn: 上至贝特曷革拉，经过贝特阿辣巴北部，上至勒乌本人波罕的磐石；

text_en: and the boundary goes up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, and so northward, turning toward Gilgal, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the valley; and the boundary passes along to the waters of En-shemesh, and ends at En-rogel;
text_cn: 再由此上至德彼尔，沿阿苛尔山谷，往北转向位于谷南的阿杜明山坡对面的革里罗特，再经舍默士水泉，直到洛革耳泉。

text_en: then the boundary goes up by the valley of the son of Hinnom at the southern slope of the Jebusites (that is, Jerusalem); and the boundary goes up to the top of the mountain that lies over against the valley of Hinnom, on the west, at the northern end of the valley of Rephaim;
text_cn: 以后再由此沿本希农山谷而上，直达耶步斯，即耶路撒冷的南侧，再上至俯视本希农山谷西方的山顶，这山位于勒法因平原的北端。

text_en: then the boundary extends from the top of the mountain to the spring of the Waters of Nephtoah, and from there to the towns of Mount Ephron; then the boundary bends around to Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim);
text_cn: 再由这山顶转向乃费托亚水泉，直到厄斐龙山，然后转向巴阿拉，──即克黎雅特耶阿陵。

text_en: and the boundary circles west of Baalah to Mount Seir, passes along to the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Chesalon), and goes down to Beth-shemesh, and passes along by Timnah;
text_cn: 再从巴阿拉向西折向色依尔山，绕过耶阿陵即革撒隆山脊北部，下至贝特舍默士，经过提默纳，

text_en: the boundary goes out to the slope of the hill north of Ekron, then the boundary bends around to Shikkeron, and passes along to Mount Baalah, and goes out to Jabneel; then the boundary comes to an end at the sea.
text_cn: 直至厄刻龙山脊北部，再绕过史加龙，经巴阿拉山，直到雅贝乃耳，最后至海为止。

text_en: And the west boundary was the Mediterranean with its coast. This is the boundary surrounding the people of Judah according to their families.
text_cn: 西方的边界以大海海滨为界：以上是犹大子孙按照家族所分得的地区四周的边界。

text_en: According to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, he gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion among the people of Judah, Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron (Arba was the father of Anak).
text_cn: 若苏厄遵照上主的吩咐，将犹大子孙中的一部分土地，即克黎雅特阿尔巴，分给了耶孚乃的儿子加肋布。阿尔巴是阿纳克的祖先，阿尔巴即是赫贝龙。

text_en: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak.
text_cn: 加肋布从那里赶走了阿纳克的三个子孙：舍瑟、阿希曼和塔耳买；他们是阿纳克的后代。

text_en: From there he went up against the inhabitants of Debir; now the name of Debir formerly was Kiriath-sepher.
text_cn: 加肋布又从那里上去，攻打了德彼尔居民。──德彼尔以前叫克黎雅特色费尔。

text_en: And Caleb said, “Whoever attacks Kiriath-sepher and takes it, to him I will give my daughter Achsah as wife. ”
text_cn: 加肋布说：“谁能征服或拿下克黎雅特色费尔，我便将我的女儿阿革撒给他为妻。”

text_en: Othniel son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it; and he gave him his daughter Achsah as wife.
text_cn: 加肋布的弟兄，刻纳次的儿子敖特尼耳夺下了那城，加肋布便将自己的女儿阿革撒给他为妻。

text_en: When she came to him, she urged him to ask her father for a field. As she dismounted from her donkey, Caleb said to her, “What do you wish? ”
text_cn: 阿革撒快过门的时候，丈夫劝她向她的父亲要求一块田地。阿革撒一下驴，加肋布便向她说：“你要什么？”

text_en: She said to him, “Give me a present; since you have set me in the land of the Negeb, give me springs of water as well. ” So Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
text_cn: 阿革撒答说：“请你给我一件礼物；你既把我安置于南方的旱地，求你也将水泉给我。”她的父亲就把上泉和下泉赐给了她。

text_en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Judah according to their families.
text_cn: 以下是犹大支派子孙，按照家族分得的产业：

text_en: The towns belonging to the tribe of the people of Judah in the extreme south, toward the boundary of Edom, were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
text_cn: 犹大支派子孙在乃革布与厄东交界的城市，有卡贝责耳、阿辣得、雅古尔、

text_en: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
text_cn: 克纳狄摩纳、阿尔阿辣。

text_en: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
text_cn: 刻德士、哈祚尔、依特南、

text_en: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
text_cn: 齐弗、特冷、贝阿罗特、

text_en: Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron (that is, Hazor),
text_cn: 哈祚尔哈达大、克黎约特赫兹龙──即哈祚尔、

text_en: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
text_cn: 阿曼、舍玛、摩拉达、

text_en: Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet,
text_cn: 哈匝尔加达、赫市孟、贝特培肋特、

text_en: Hazar-shual, Beer-sheba, Biziothiah,
text_cn: 哈匝尔叔阿耳、贝尔舍巴及所属村镇、

text_en: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,
text_cn: 巴阿拉、依因、厄曾、

text_en: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,
text_cn: 厄耳托拉得、革息耳、曷尔玛、

text_en: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
text_cn: 漆刻拉格、玛德玛纳、桑森纳、

text_en: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon: in all, twenty-nine towns, with their villages.
text_cn: 肋巴敖特、史耳新和恩黎孟：共计二十九座城和所属村镇。

text_en: And in the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
text_cn: 在盆地有厄市陶耳、祚辣、阿市纳、

text_en: Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
text_cn: 匝诺亚、恩加宁、塔普亚、厄南、

text_en: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,
text_cn: 雅尔慕特、阿杜蓝、索苛、阿则卡、

text_en: Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, Gederothaim: fourteen towns with their villages.
text_cn: 沙阿辣因、阿狄塔殷、革德辣及革德洛塔殷：共计十四座城和所属村镇。

text_en: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad,
text_cn: 责南、哈达沙、米革达耳加得、

text_en: Dilan, Mizpeh, Jokthe-el,
text_cn: 狄耳罕、米兹培、约刻特耳、

text_en: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
text_cn: 拉基士、波兹卡特、厄革隆、

text_en: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,
text_cn: 加朋、拉赫玛斯、基特里士、

text_en: Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah: sixteen towns with their villages.
text_cn: 革德洛特、贝特达贡、纳阿玛、玛刻达：共计十六座城和所属村镇。

text_en: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
text_cn: 里贝纳、厄特尔、阿商、

text_en: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
text_cn: 依弗达、阿市纳、乃漆布、

text_en: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah: nine towns with their villages.
text_cn: 刻依拉、阿革齐布、玛勒沙：共计九座城和所属村镇；

text_en: Ekron, with its dependencies and its villages;
text_cn: 尚有厄刻龙和所属的城镇。

text_en: from Ekron to the sea, all that were near Ashdod, with their villages.
text_cn: 还有从厄刻龙到海，所有靠近阿市多得的城邑和所属村镇。

text_en: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the Wadi of Egypt, and the Great Sea with its coast.
text_cn: 阿市多得和所属城镇，迦萨和所属城镇，直到埃及小河；并以大海为界。

text_en: And in the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,
text_cn: 在山地有沙米尔，雅提尔、索苛，

text_en: Dannah, Kiriath-sannah (that is, Debir),
text_cn: 达纳、克黎雅特色费尔即德彼尔、

text_en: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
text_cn: 阿纳布、厄市特摩、阿宁、

text_en: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh: eleven towns with their villages.
text_cn: 哥笙、曷隆和基罗：共计十一座城和所属村镇。

text_en: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,
text_cn: 阿辣布、杜玛、厄商、

text_en: Janim, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,
text_cn: 雅农、贝特塔普亚、阿费克、

text_en: Humtah, Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), and Zior: nine towns with their villages.
text_cn: 胡默达、克黎雅特阿尔巴即赫贝龙和漆敖尔：共计九座城和所属村镇。

text_en: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,
text_cn: 玛红、加尔默耳、齐弗、犹他、

text_en: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
text_cn: 依次勒耳、约刻德罕、匝诺亚，

text_en: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah: ten towns with their villages.
text_cn: 卡因、基贝亚、提默纳：共计十座城和所属村镇。

text_en: Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
text_cn: 哈耳胡耳、贝特族尔、革多尔、

text_en: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon: six towns with their villages.
text_cn: 玛阿辣特、贝特阿诺特、厄耳特孔：共计六座城和所属村镇。特科亚、厄弗辣大即白冷、培敖尔、厄堂、谷隆、塔堂、索勒、加伦、加林、贝特尔、玛纳：共计十一座城和所属村镇。

text_en: Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim) and Rabbah: two towns with their villages.
text_cn: 尚有克黎雅特巴耳即克黎雅特耶阿陵和阿辣巴两座城，和所属村镇。

text_en: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah,
text_cn: 在旷野有贝特阿辣巴、米丁、色加加、

text_en: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi: six towns with their villages.
text_cn: 尼贝商、盐城和恩革狄：共计六座城和所属村镇。

text_en: But the people of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so the Jebusites live with the people of Judah in Jerusalem to this day.
text_cn: 至于住在耶路撒冷的耶步斯人，犹大人不能将他们赶走，因此耶步斯人直到今日，仍同犹大人一起住在耶路撒冷。
